notes.title: Dreamweaver Hollow Playtest Event
notes.notes:
📢 Equiverse Playtesting Event – Join Now!

Be among the first to explore the second world of Equiverse! 🚀 Play, report bugs, share feedback, and earn exclusive rewards!

🎮 How to Join?
1️⃣ Sign up via Steam Playtest on the Equiverse Steam page:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950400/Equiverse/ 

2️⃣ Join the Discord and report bugs or share feedback:
🔗  https://discord.gg/hay2fMBggT

🏆 What’s in it for you?
✅ Instant Playtester Role – Gain a special role in Discord upon approved feedback or bug reports!
✅ Exclusive Rewards – Five lucky playtesters will receive a free key for the full release of Equiverse!
✅ Steam Gift Cards – Win one of three €5 or one €10 Steam gift cards!

💡 How to Win? Report at least one bug AND share useful feedback in the Discord. Once I approve your reports, you're entered into the prize draw!

Help shape the future of Equiverse—sign up now and start testing! 🌿
